verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes Android app-size optimization and a lightweight application footprint as persistent implementation objectives.
First concrete baseline failure: the Android build measured 126 MB and lacked App Bundle packaging, code shrinking, and image optimization.
The exchange adopts reusable tutorial backgrounds with separately rendered localized text, changing the application asset strategy used to reduce package size.
The client makes the smallest possible application footprint a concrete implementation priority; the update is compatible with the existing optimization goal.
First concrete post-optimization verification: the executed Android build measured 44.6 MB, approximately 70% smaller than its 148.8 MB baseline.
Replacing the localized tutorial content with one shared How-To video makes the prior reusable-background tutorial strategy obsolete; the removed key exists in the replayed state.
External streaming prevents the How-To video from being bundled into the application and increasing the Android package footprint.
